brief: Prioritise Willow Bend for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal cycling [MG-023]. Review the asset's open defect register against its ability to shed heat before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows [SOP-016]. If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023].
